snippet.title: Antz Extreme Racing - Full Game Walkthrough
snippet.description:
Antz Extreme Racing is a racing video game developed by Supersonic Software and published by Empire Interactive, originally released in July 2002. The game features characters from the 1998 animated movie Antz, and allows players to race as one of several characters from the movie. The game includes a variety of race tracks and game modes, including time trials and championship modes, and features a variety of power-ups and weapons to use against other racers. The game's plot is primarily focused on the racing aspect and does not feature a specific story or plotline.

===== Mods Used =====
• dgVoodoo2: http://dege.freeweb.hu/dgVoodoo2/dgVoodoo2/
• Widescreen Fix (by Automaniak and me): https://community.pcgamingwiki.com/files/file/2386-antz-extreme-racing-widescreen-fix/

===== Game Info =====
• Developers: Supersonic Software (PC, XBOX & PS2), Magic Pockets (GBA)
• Publisher: Empire Interactive
• Initial release date: July 26, 2002
• Plaforms: Microsoft Windows, Xbox, PlayStation 2, Game Boy Advance
• Genre: Racing
• Engine: RenderWare (DirectX 8.1)

===== Walkthrough Info =====
• Platform: Microsoft Windows
• Recording: Bandicam
• Editing: VEGAS Pro 19

===== Additional Info =====
• Essential improvements: https://www.pcgamingwiki.com/wiki/Antz_Extreme_Racing
• More walkthroughs: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLnNwhD2cojsdYDEittmw9N1OJ94CQ07eh
